# Vibe Defender

> OWASP security scanner that audits websites and web applications for vulnerabilities, misconfigurations, and compliance issues.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Free security scanner for websites. Scan any URL for OWASP Top 10 vulnerabilities, misconfigurations, and security headers.
- [Methodology](/methodology): How the Vibe Defender security scan works — the checks we run, the standards we follow, and how we grade risk.
- [Contact](/contact): Get in touch with the Vibe Defender team for support, feedback, or partnership inquiries.
- [Privacy](/privacy): Privacy policy covering data collection, scan logs, and how user information is handled.
- [Terms](/terms): Terms of service for using the Vibe Defender security scanning platform.
